15.t: 4. High-Score Mode The High-Score Mode begins when a player has earned one of the eleven highest scores. If a player has earned the highest score, a special option allows him to sign his name using the Midi Trak-Ball™, as well as enter his initials into the highscore table. Characters of the alphabet appear on the screen. The player rotates the Midi Trak-Ball™ to locate his initial. He circles his initials and they appear in the center of the screen. Then the initials and score are transfered into the high-score table. To reset the high-score table, refer to Chapter 2. ‘Set-Up Procedures.
